Attackers can send a crafted advanced_filter parameter containing a single quote to the Reports getRecordsCount action to break out of BETWEEN literals and extract database contents.

Meilisearch before 1.55.1 and 1.56.x before 1.56.1 contains a quadratic memory consumption vulnerability in filter-parser that allows attackers with a search API key to exhaust server memory. Attackers can send a roughly 100 KB filter, such as a _geoPolygon with thousands of coordinates, to the search endpoint, crashing the server and taking all indexes offline.

Attendize through 2.8.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in EventOrdersController::postCancelOrder() that allows authenticated organisers to cancel attendees belonging to other accounts' events. Attackers can cancel one of their own orders while supplying foreign attendee IDs, which Attendee::findFromSelection() loads unfiltered, invalidating tickets for any event on the installation.

A server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in the Pure Storage FlashArray extension for Windows Admin Center versions could allow an authenticated Gateway User to direct the management gateway to an unintended host, potentially exposing stored FlashArray credentials and API tokens and allowing unauthorized access to the managed FlashArray.

Chamilo LMS is an open-source learning management system. Prior to 1.11.40 and 2.0.1, main/lp/lp_ajax_save_objectives.php and public/main/lp/lp_ajax_save_objectives.php trust the request uid parameter instead of the authenticated user identity when saving SCORM learning objectives. Any authenticated student can replace uid with another user's identifier and overwrite that user's objectives because the endpoint performs no ownership check. This issue is fixed in versions 1.11.40 and 2.0.1.

Mareforma is a local verification layer for AI-assisted research. From 0.3.0 until 0.3.7, the _maybe_update_replicated_unlocked convergence path in mareforma/db/core.py uses generated_by labels without requiring a valid signature_bundle from a distinct enrolled signer, so an unsigned claim written to a shared graph can converge with a signed peer and be promoted to REPLICATED. The forged trust state is returned by queries requiring REPLICATED support, allowing false multi-party endorsement signals to reach downstream consumers. This issue is fixed in version 0.3.7.

keystore-go is a Go implementation of the Java KeyStore encoder and decoder. In 2.1.0 and earlier, keystore.Decode in decoder.go does not check the error returned when reading the trailing SHA-1 integrity digest and bounds its comparison by the length of the digest actually read. If an attacker with write access removes the final 20-byte digest from a modified JKS file, the empty actual digest causes the comparison loop to execute zero times and Decode returns the parsed keystore without an error. For certificate-only stores using TrustedCertificateEntry values, this bypasses both tamper detection and password verification, allowing trusted CA certificates to be added or replaced without knowing the keystore password and potentially enabling interception or modification of TLS connections that trust the forged CA. This issue is fixed in version 3.0.0.

An unauthenticated buffer overflow vulnerability exists in the underlying operating system of AOS-10 or AOS-8 and could allow an unauthenticated adjacent attacker to conduct a denial of service attack. Successful exploitation could allow an attacker to disrupt the availability of the affected system, with a limited impact to the integrity of the affected component.

NocoDB from 2026.07.0 before 2026.10.0 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows users with Creator role to inject SQL through unescaped backslashes in the DATETIME_FORMAT formula format argument on MySQL-backed bases. Attackers can place a backslash before a quote to terminate the DATE_FORMAT string literal and read any data reachable by the data source's database user, including tables outside the base.

NocoDB before 2026.07.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in its MySQL and SQLite clients that inserts the column precision value into generated data-definition statements without numeric validation. Authenticated users with the Creator or Owner base role can supply a crafted precision value when creating or updating a column to close the type declaration and execute arbitrary SQL against the base's data source.

A vulnerability has been found in GearUP Hyperev up to 20261020. This affects an unknown function. Such manipulation leads to on-chip debug and test interface with improper access control. The attack can be executed directly on the physical device. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

Chamilo LMS is an open-source learning management system. Prior to 1.11.40 on the 1.11 release line and in 2.0.0, plugin/cleandeletedfiles/src/ajax.php and public/plugin/CleanDeletedFiles/src/ajax.php pass the request path parameter and list parameter directly to unlink without canonicalization, filename validation, or confinement to the plugin's scanned directories. An authenticated administrator can delete arbitrary files writable by the web server; a cross-site request forgery against an administrator session can reach the same operation. Deleting application source, uploaded content, cache, or configuration files can cause data loss and denial of service. This issue is fixed in version 1.11.40 on the 1.11 release line. No fixed 2.0 release is established as of this review.

Jane is a set of PHP libraries that generates models and API clients from JSON Schema and OpenAPI specifications. Prior to 7.12.0, Jane's Reference.php::doResolve passes an attacker-controlled OpenAPI $ref target to file_get_contents without restricting its scheme or resolved local path. When a victim generates code from an attacker-influenced document, an HTTP or HTTPS reference can cause requests to attacker-chosen or internal services, while an absolute or parent-relative path can read local JSON or YAML files and inline the retrieved content into generated output. Exploitation occurs during generation or CI processing and can disclose local files and internal-service responses. This issue is fixed in version 7.12.0.

Mareforma is a local verification layer for AI-assisted research. From 0.3.0 until 0.3.8, verify_bundle in mareforma/export_bundle.py validates the outer DSSE envelope and exporter-signed subject digests, but JSONLDExporter._claim_node in mareforma/exporters/jsonld.py supplies no signatureBundle for individual claims. Because the exporter signs both the predicate nodes and their digest list, the check proves only internal bundle consistency and allows claims with missing, invalid, or forged asserter signatures to be accepted as authentic. This issue is fixed in version 0.3.8.

Kiwi TCMS before 8.6 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the User.filter JSON-RPC method that allows unauthenticated attackers to retrieve user account information. Attackers can send a POST request to /json-rpc/ invoking User.filter with a query parameter to disclose sensitive user data without authentication. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-19.

Zhongqing Naboo Education Cloud Platform builds through 2021-07-09 contain a missing authentication vulnerability in the /api/TeacherQuery/SearchTeacherInSiteWithPagerRecords endpoint that allows unauthenticated attackers to access sensitive teacher data. Attackers can send unauthenticated GET requests to this endpoint to retrieve user names, login names, and admin ids from the JSON response. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-11-15.

CAST Imaging has a missing authentication vulnerability in the "/api/auth/keycloak/users/{username}" endpoint. An unauthenticated remote attacker can modify the email address of an arbitrary Keycloak user and access sensitive account information, including the API authentication token hash. This can lead to account takeover, user impersonation and user enumeration.


The vulnerability has only been confirmed in version 3.6.2 but may also affect other versions. The vendor did not provide the affected version range, but assured that the vulnerability is fixed "in newer versions".

Out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the pixReadMemJp2kCore() function in Leptonica, located in jp2kio.c. The function retrieves the output dimensions only for component 0 and uses a common index to iterate through the buffers of all components. If the remaining components have smaller dimensions, the traversal exceeds the bounds of their sample buffers, which are allocated by OpenJPEG. When processing a specially crafted JPEG 2000 image, data read from adjacent dynamic memory may be incorporated into the pixels of the decoded image and result in information disclosure to anyone who can access the output.

Inefficient Algorithmic Complexity vulnerability in benoitc idna allows an attacker who controls a hostname passed to the library to exhaust CPU via an over-long xn-- label. idna:ulabel/1 in src/idna.erl hands every ASCII label that starts with xn-- to punycode:decode/1 without applying check_label_length/1, the 63-octet DNS label limit. punycode:decode/1 in src/punycode.erl builds its output with list appends in insert/4, so its cost grows super-linearly with the label length. A label of a few kilobytes keeps a scheduler busy for seconds to minutes before the label is rejected as invalid punycode.

Every decode entry point reaches this path: decode/1, decode/2, to_unicode/1 and from_ascii/1. The encode path reaches it as well, because alabel/1 calls ulabel/1 on an ASCII xn-- label before its own length check, so encode/1, encode/2 and to_ascii/1 are affected for such input.

This issue affects idna: from 0.5.0 before 8.0.0.

ImageMagick before 7.1.2-35 contains a denial of service vulnerability in the BGR, CMYK, GRAY, RGB, YCBCR and YUV decoders that allows attackers to crash the application. Attackers can supply a crafted image to these decoders to trigger a crash and disrupt image processing services.

ImageMagick before 7.1.2-35 contains a policy bypass vulnerability in various coders that allows attackers to allocate excessive memory by supplying images with many profiles. Attackers can craft images containing a high number of embedded profiles to exhaust memory and cause denial of service, bypassing security policy limits.

ImageMagick before 7.1.2-35 contains a policy bypass vulnerability in the ASE decoder caused by a missing security policy check. Attackers can supply crafted ASE files that evade configured resource policies to cause excessive memory usage and denial of service.

ImageMagick before 7.1.2-35 contains a policy bypass vulnerability that allows attackers to evade resource limits because a policy check is missing when reading XMP profiles. Attackers can supply an image with a crafted XMP profile to trigger excessive memory usage and cause denial of service.

NocoDB before 2026.10.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read hidden columns by supplying comma-separated group-by column lists. Attackers with a shared view link can pair a visible and hidden column to bypass restrictSharedViewColumnReferences and retrieve hidden values tied to individual rows.

NocoDB before 2026.10.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated shared view link holders to read hidden columns by grouping on physical column names. Attackers can supply a hidden column's physical name or the unchecked sub-group parameter to the public group-by endpoint to reveal hidden values, counts, and column existence.

NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated shared-base link holders to read the base's stored plaintext password through the general base metadata endpoint. Attackers with a share link can query the base read or list responses in bases.controller.ts, which skip password stripping in sanitizeBase.ts, to obtain reusable plaintext passwords.

NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to access records hidden by a shared view's row filter by supplying arbitrary primary keys. Attackers with the share link can request attachment downloads and many-to-many or has-many link listings for excluded records to obtain their attachment files and linked record identities.

NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains an authorization bypass in shared-view relation endpoints because parent-record lookups apply only the primary key, not the view's row filter. Anonymous share-link holders can enumerate auto-increment primary keys against the has-many, many-to-many, one-to-many and link-to-another-record routes to read linked records of filtered-out rows.

Network-AI from 5.11.0 before 5.17.2 contains a CORS misconfiguration in McpStreamableServer that reflects localhost Origins into Access-Control-Allow-Origin regardless of bind interface. Attackers controlling a localhost-origin page or DNS-rebinding name can read unauthenticated /tools and /health responses, exposing tool catalogs and bridge metadata on non-loopback binds.

SemanticMediaWiki from 7.3.0 before 7.4.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the smwtask API check-query task that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass object-level authorization by relying on the wiki-wide edit right. Attackers can supply arbitrary subject titles, including protected pages, to run synchronous Semantic MediaWiki queries with caller-controlled conditions, limit, offset, and querymode parameters.

A weakness has been identified in Directus up to 12.6.1. Affected by this issue is the function getSecret of the file api/src/services/shares.ts of the component Share Login Service. This manipulation causes incorrect authorization. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.

A vulnerability was identified in Directus up to 12.7.0. This issue affects the function AuthenticationService.refresh of the file api/src/services/authentication.ts of the component Authentication Service. Such manipulation leads to session expiration. The attack can be launched remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.

MediaInfoLib before 26.10 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in File_Mpeg4::meta_iloc that allows attackers to trigger a global buffer over-read via oversized iloc field sizes. Attackers can supply a crafted MP4 file with invalid offset_size or length_size values to overrun the BitStream_Fast mask table and crash applications analysing the file.

MediaInfoLib before 26.10 contains a heap-based buffer over-read vulnerability in tfsxml_leave() caused by an off-by-one error when handling generic <! markup in truncated XML. Attackers can supply a crafted media file with malformed ADM XML parsed by File_Adm.cpp to crash MediaInfo or applications using MediaInfoLib.

GPAC MP4Box before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability because gf_node_free() frees nodes without detaching routes that still reference them via FromNode. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene with nested PROTO graphs so gf_sg_route_del() accesses freed memory, crashing MP4Box and potentially corrupting the heap.

GPAC before 26.07.0 contains an integer underflow vulnerability in gf_xml_sax_peek_node() that allows attackers to write a zero byte outside the heap line buffer via crafted XML attribute values. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file with a ROUTE or command referencing an undefined node, imported with MP4Box, to crash the process and corrupt memory.

GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT loader that leaves ROUTE commands of a discarded node queued after being freed by gf_sg_command_del(). Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene file imported with MP4Box so xmt_resolve_routes() writes to freed memory, corrupting the heap and crashing the process.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in gf_node_try_destroy because Conditional node commands keep raw pointers to target nodes freed by gf_sg_reset(). Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene processed with -info or -add to trigger heap use-after-free, crashing the process and corrupting heap memory.

GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in MP4Box because gf_sg_reset frees DEF'd proto sub-graph nodes without removing them from the GF_Proto node_code list. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene with nested PROTOs so gf_sg_proto_del unregisters freed nodes during teardown, crashing MP4Box and corrupting the heap.

GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a type confusion vulnerability in xmt_parse_script_field() that allows attackers to trigger a heap out-of-bounds read via duplicate Script field names with conflicting types. Attackers can craft an XMT file that, when imported with MP4Box, causes gf_sg_vrml_mf_reset() to treat a single-value field as multi-value, crashing the application.

GPAC MP4Box before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT parser that leaves parser->command_buffer pointing into a freed InputSensor node. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene file triggering a parse error so xmt_node_start() writes NULL into freed memory, corrupting the heap and crashing MP4Box.

GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in xmt_node_end() that allows attackers to corrupt memory by attaching nodes from unrelated proto sub-graphs to field-replace commands. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene buffering such a command in a Conditional node, causing gf_node_try_destroy() to access the freed node, crashing MP4Box and corrupting the heap.

GPAC MP4Box before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in Conditional_execute() because SetupConditional() stores a BIFS decoder pointer that gf_sm_load_run_isom() later frees without clearing. Attackers can supply a crafted MP4 file with a BIFS Conditional node processed with -nstatx to crash MP4Box and potentially corrupt the heap.

The GLPI Inventory Plugin handles network discovery, inventory, software deployment, and data collection for GLPI agents. Prior to 1.6.8, the /b/deploy, /b/collect, and /b/esx agent API endpoints do not authenticate requests before processing Deploy, Collect, and ESX task operations. An unauthenticated remote attacker can enumerate jobs and manipulate their status through these endpoints, disclosing job information and interfering with task processing. This issue is fixed in version 1.6.8.

QPixel is a Q&A-based community knowledge-sharing software. Prior to 0.13.0, the unauthenticated comments#show action in app/controllers/comments_controller.rb resolves user-controlled comment IDs with Comment.unscoped, bypassing the Comment community default scope, and performs no deletion or post-visibility authorization check. A remote unauthenticated attacker can enumerate sequential IDs and read the full content of comments belonging to other communities, soft-deleted comments, and comments under access-restricted categories. The JSON response exposes the stored comment columns because the model has no limiting as_json override. This issue is fixed in version 0.13.0.

Mareforma is a local verification layer for AI-assisted research. From 0.3.0 until 0.3.8, restore logic in mareforma/db/restore.py derives transparency_logged from the unsigned rekor.uuid field inside signature_bundle without requiring a verified claim-bound rekor_inclusions entry, so an attacker who modifies claims.toml can falsely make a claim eligible for REPLICATED convergence. The same logic resets signed claims in non-Rekor graphs from transparency_logged 1 to 0 after restore, permanently preventing convergence because no Rekor refresh is configured. This issue is fixed in version 0.3.8.

advisories.title:
The Deco BE65 v3 firmware contains a shared hard-coded password hash for the root account in /etc/shadow. Where the corresponding credential is accepted by a production authentication path, an attacker with existing unprivileged shell access may recover or otherwise obtain the plaintext password and use it to escalate privileges. 

Successful exploitation may grant root-level access to the affected device.
Exploit for CVE-2026-131873

MP4v2 through 2.1.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in MP4RtpHintTrack::GetPayload() in src/rtphint.cpp that passes an unchecked rtpmap value to strchr(). Attackers can supply a crafted MP4 file whose RTP hint track has a corrupted hinf atom to crash mp4info or applications calling MP4GetHintTrackRtpPayload().

GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in DoWriteMeta() in src/isomedia/isom_store.c that allows attackers to crash MP4Box via crafted files. Attackers can supply an ISOBMFF file with a meta box containing an iloc entry but no dref box, crashing MP4Box during rewrite operations like -unhint.

GPAC MP4Box before 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in xmt_node_end() that allows attackers to crash the application through an unmatched closing ProtoDeclare element. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT-A scene file with a mismatched closing ProtoDeclare or ExternProtoDeclare element, causing a dereference of a NULL parsing_proto pointer and denial of service.

GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in gf_isom_get_meta() in src/isomedia/meta.c that reads file->moov->trackList without checking the moov box exists. Attackers can supply a crafted ISOBMFF file with malformed AV1 configuration data that leaves moov unset, crashing MP4Box -infon and causing denial of service.

GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in gf_node_try_destroy that allows attackers to crash MP4Box by supplying crafted XMT scene files. Commands created inside a PROTO scope keep a raw pointer to a freed prototype sub-scene graph, which is read during teardown, causing denial of service.

GPAC MP4Box before 26.07.0 contains a divide by zero vulnerability in DumpTrackInfo() in applications/mp4box/filedump.c that fails to check the media timescale for zero. Attackers can supply a crafted MP4 file with a zero media timescale to make MP4Box -infon raise SIGFPE and crash, causing denial of service.

GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in xmt_parse_command() in loader_xmt.c that allows attackers to crash MP4Box via unchecked field lookups. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene whose atIndexField names a non-existent node field, causing a NULL read during import and denial of service.

GPAC MP4Box before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in xmt_find_node() in loader_xmt.c that leaves freed forward-referenced nodes cached in parser->peeked_nodes. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file with a node targeted by an SFCommandBuffer command, triggering a later DEF lookup on the freed node and crashing MP4Box.

GPAC MP4Box before 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in xmt_parse_proto() in loader_xmt.c that allows attackers to crash the process via a redefined ProtoDeclare name. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file with a duplicate ProtoDeclare name, causing gf_sg_proto_new() to return NULL and crashing MP4Box during import.

GPAC before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in ReplaceDEFNode that allows attackers to crash MP4Box by triggering access to a partly freed child list. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene file whose InputSensor command buffer cascades prototype sub-graph deletion during gf_sg_vrml_parent_destroy, causing denial of service.

GPAC MP4Box before 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT loader that allows attackers to crash the process by supplying crafted XMT files. Attackers can assign a second node to an SFNode command field so xmt_node_end() frees a forward-referenced child still cached in peeked_nodes, triggering a crash during DEF lookup in xmt_find_node().

GPAC before 26.07.0 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in gf_sg_proto_field_is_sftime_offset() in src/scenegraph/vrml_proto.c that allows attackers to crash MP4Box via crafted files. Attackers can supply an MP4 file whose BIFS scene contains cyclic PROTO IS relations, causing unbounded recursion that exhausts the stack and causes denial of service.

Mareforma is a local verification layer for AI-assisted research. From 0.3.0 until 0.3.8, _maybe_update_replicated_unlocked in mareforma/db/core.py does not check t_invalid in its new-claim gate, peer-selection query, or final update, so a claim marked invalid by a signed contradiction verdict can still be promoted to REPLICATED through convergence. The invalidated claim can also act as the corroborating peer that promotes an honest claim, bypassing the trust ladder's terminal refutation state. This issue is fixed in version 0.3.8.

Mareforma is a local verification layer for AI-assisted research. From 0.3.7 until 0.3.8, search_claims in mareforma/db/core.py does not call _row_verified_on_read and therefore does not provide the same high-trust verification projection as query_claims. A forged or tampered REPLICATED or ESTABLISHED row that query_claims excludes can be returned by search_claims at its persisted trust level, and the missing verified marker prevents consumers from detecting that signature verification was skipped. The include_unverified option does not authorize this high-trust bypass. This issue is fixed in version 0.3.8.

Mattermost versions 11.11.x <= 11.11.0, 11.7.x <= 11.7.11, 11.10.x <= 11.10.2 fail to check whether the calling session originated from an OAuth authorization grant, which allows a third-party application holding a delegated access token to register a new, independent OAuth application under the identity of the delegating user via the OAuth application registration endpoint.. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00780

ImageMagick before 7.1.2-35 contains a code injection vulnerability in the MAGICK, XBM, XPM and UIL encoders that allows local attackers to inject content via crafted filenames. Attackers with access to the output directory and control over the filename can inject additional headers or code into the generated image source output.

Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC), versions prior to 6.14.105.0, contain a Least Privilege Violation vulnerability. A low privileged attacker with local access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Elevation of Privilege and Denial of Service.
Tanium addressed an improper check for certificate revocation vulnerability.
In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.1.3, 2025.11.7 privilege escalation to system administrator was possible after disabling per-project permissions

X-Road is open-source data exchange layer software. Prior to 7.8.2 and 7.7.3, the Configuration Proxy uses attacker-controlled Content-location metadata from a validly signed federated global configuration part when constructing an output path without verifying that the resulting path remains inside the intended configuration output directory. A malicious or compromised federated ecosystem can provide an absolute path or directory traversal sequence during the normal refresh cycle, causing the Configuration Proxy to create a new file with attacker-controlled content under the permissions of the non-privileged xroad process. The vulnerability can poison downstream global configuration or create files in other writable locations, but it does not overwrite existing files. This issue is fixed in versions 7.8.2 and 7.7.3.

OliveTin gives safe and simple access to predefined shell commands from a web interface. From 3000.0.0 until 3000.18.1, OliveTin passes attacker-influenceable output and ot_username values into shellAfterCompleted processing in service/internal/executor/executor.go without applying checkShellArgumentSafety, the shell-safety validation used for primary action execution. The same post-execution template path also expands exitCode without that validation, but the advisory does not establish attacker control of the exit-code value. When an action configures shellAfterCompleted with output or ot_username, shell metacharacters from command output, external data processed by an action, or a trusted-header username can become syntax in the command executed by the stepExecAfter path. This can execute arbitrary commands as the OliveTin process user, including when the primary action uses the safer exec-array mode. This issue is fixed in version 3000.18.1.
Exploit for CVE-2026-95267
Tanium addressed an improper access controls vulnerability in Tanium Server.
Tanium addressed an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in Tanium Client.

The Toolbox for Asgaros Forum plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to arbitrary file deletion due to insufficient file path validation in the replace_temp_pics function in all versions up to, and including, 1.2.4. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to delete arbitrary files on the server, which can easily lead to remote code execution when the right file is deleted (such as wp-config.php). This vulnerability is only reachable when the site administrator has enabled the Inline Image Upload feature (disabled by default).

The PowerPress Podcasting plugin by Blubrry plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Directory Traversal in all versions up to, and including, 11.18.2 via the 'podcast-images[] (actually `${feed_slug}-images[]`)' parameter parameter. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to read the contents of arbitrary image files on the server, which can contain sensitive information.

The Search Everything plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Sensitive Information Exposure in versions up to, and including, 8.1.9 via the search_everything AJAX action. The handler registered at `wp_ajax_search_everything` performs no capability check, no ownership check, and no nonce verification before running a WP_Query over `$_GET['s']` and returning the raw WP_Post objects — including the `post_password` field — as JSON. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Subscriber-level access and above, to extract cleartext passwords for every password-protected post on the site and, when the plugin's draft/attachment/metadata search options are enabled by an administrator, to read draft and pending post contents they otherwise have no capability to view.

Mattermost Desktop App versions <=6.3 6.0.3 6.3.2.0 fail to bound the Calls widget resize dimensions before applying them to the window, which allows a configured Mattermost server to terminate the Desktop App process via a crafted resizeCallsWidget IPC message sent from the Calls widget window. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00787

The BlockArt Blocks – Gutenberg Blocks, Page Builder Blocks ,WordPress Block Plugin, Sections & Template Library plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 2.4.3. This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to view the title, excerpt, and full content of other users' draft, pending, and private posts, exposing that content to unauthenticated visitors on the published permalink. This is exploitable by an Author-level user because WordPress's wp_filter_post_kses preserves block-comment JSON in HTML comments, allowing the malicious queryArgs and query[post_status] attributes to survive post saving and execute on every unauthenticated request to the published URL. Exploitation by attackers with contributor-level access and above requires that attacker only needs to see the data themselves (not expose it to unauthenticated visitors) — satisfied by viewing their own preview URL. On a default installation, where that is not configured, the vulnerability requires attackers with author-level access and above.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in WP Media WP Rocket wp-rocket allows Stored XSS.This issue affects WP Rocket: from n/a before 3.24.1.

The GamiPress – Gamification plugin to reward points, badges & ranks in WordPress, now with AI plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'name-1[compare]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 8.1.3 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database. Exploitation requires that an administrator has published at least one GamiPress achievement step triggered by a Forminator field-value submission event, as the GamiPress Forminator integration listener is the only path that routes a form submission's raw field array — including the attacker-controlled compare operator — into gamipress_query_logs().

Dokploy is a free, self-hostable Platform as a Service (PaaS). Prior to 0.31.1, the settings.getWebServerSettings protected procedure returns the complete global web-server settings object to any authenticated member, including the stored sshPrivateKey, even though settings.saveSSHPrivateKey requires an administrator. A default member can therefore retrieve infrastructure, deployment, or server-management credentials that only an administrator can configure. This issue is fixed in version 0.31.1.
Tanium addressed an information disclosure vulnerability.

Mattermost versions 11.11.x <= 11.11.0, 11.7.x <= 11.7.11, 11.10.x <= 11.10.2 fail to bound the resources consumed while processing an uploaded custom emoji image which allows an authenticated user with default permissions to make the server unresponsive for all users via repeated custom emoji uploads.. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00720

The Elementor Website Builder – More Than Just a Page Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Sensitive Information Exposure in all versions up to, and including, 4.0.5 via `/wp-json/elementor/v1/user` REST endpoint. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Contributor-level access and above, to extract sensitive data including emails, password hashes and usernames for all WordPress users.

X-Road is open-source data exchange layer software. Prior to 7.8.2, 7.7.3, and 7.6.4, HashChainVerifier in the common-message module resolves attacker-controlled batch-signature hash chains before verifying the message signature and signing certificate, without cycle detection, recursion-depth or total-step limits, or per-step memoization. A registered ecosystem member can send a small crafted hashchain MIME part with repeated or cyclic StepRef values so that verifyHashChain() performs exponential work or unbounded recursion before authentication. Repeated requests can exhaust Security Server proxy threads and deny data-exchange service, and a self-reference can raise an uncaught error. This issue is fixed in versions 7.8.2, 7.7.3, and 7.6.4.

djangocms-versioning is a general-purpose versioning package for django CMS 4 and later. Prior to 2.6.1, the check_discard and check_edit_redirect Conditions on djangocms_versioning.models.Version omit user_can_change, while VersionAdmin.discard_view and VersionAdmin.edit_redirect_view obtain a version by its primary key and rely on those conditions for object-level authorization. With CMS_PERMISSION set to True, the affected views are gated only by is_staff, allowing any staff user to select content without object-level change permission. With the default CMS_PERMISSION value of False, a staff user must also hold the global Django change_ permission, but that model-level permission does not enforce the intended per-object authorization, so the user can delete a draft version and its content object through discard or create an editable draft from a published version through edit_redirect even when the user cannot change that specific content object. This issue is fixed in version 2.6.1.

Outstatic is a static site CMS for Markdown and MDX content stored in GitHub repositories. Prior to 2.2.1, the authenticated GitHub REST proxy accepts an unvalidated endpoint value, constructs an upstream URL by string concatenation, and attaches the current dashboard user's GitHub OAuth token without ensuring the destination remains the exact GitHub API origin. An authenticated dashboard user can cause the server to send that user's token to a non-GitHub host, potentially exposing private repositories and other resources allowed by the token's scopes. The issue does not let an unauthenticated attacker access private data and does not directly expose another user's token without an additional same-origin execution or request-forging primitive. This issue is fixed in version 2.2.1.
Tanium addressed a SQL injection vulnerability in multiple products.

Mattermost versions 11.7.x <= 11.7.11, 11.10.x <= 11.10.2, 11.11.x <= 11.11.1 fail to bound the work performed while reading EXIF orientation metadata, which allows an authenticated user to cause disproportionate server-side CPU usage by uploading or linking a small image with specially structured EXIF metadata.. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2026-00784

A vulnerability in the web-based management interface of network device management systems of AOS-8 Mobility Controllers could allow an authenticated remote attacker to bypass authorization controls. Successful exploitation could allow a low-privilege attacker to read sensitive configuration data potentially leading to unauthorized network access and further compromise of network security.
Exploit for Product UI does not Warn User of Unsafe Actions in Microsoft

The Delivery & Pickup Date Time for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting in versions up to, and including, 1.3.90. This is due to a nonce-only settings AJAX handler that stores an attribute-breaking value and an administrator settings template that outputs it without HTML attribute escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

The SchemaEngine AI – AI Schema Markup, Reviews & Rich Snippets for SEO plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'content/excerpt (REST wp/v2/posts) → stored in post_content/post_excerpt' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.1.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. A Contributor's entity-encoded payload survives save-time wp_kses filtering verbatim and is only decoded into raw script tags at render time via html_entity_decode(), meaning the injected script executes for every visitor — including authenticated Administrators — once an Editor publishes the post through the standard Contributor workflow.

The Jeg Kit for Elementor – Powerful Addons for Elementor, Widgets & Templates for WordPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'description' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.3.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful execution requires a published page containing both a Post Author widget in user_bio mode (rendering the attacker's biography) and any legitimate jkit_client_logo widget, so that client-logo.js is enqueued and the loadCarousel handler fires against the forged widget markup from the bio field.

The JobBoardWP – Job Board Listings and Submissions plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'job_description' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.3.6 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with custom-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The plugin's default public submission workflow auto-provisions a jb_employer account for any visitor, meaning the effective entry point is unauthenticated — the custom role requirement imposes no real barrier on a stock install.

The FS Poster - WordPress Social media Auto Poster & Scheduler [Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, Pinterest] plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Server-Side Request Forgery in all versions up to, and including, 8.0.1 via the 'site_url' parameter. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to make web requests to arbitrary locations originating from the web application and can be used to query and modify information from internal services. The Guzzle HTTP client is instantiated with TLS certificate verification disabled and redirect following enabled by default, allowing redirect-based SSRF bypasses and enabling internal port scanning via distinguishable server responses.

The WP Delicious – Recipe Plugin for Food Bloggers (formerly Delicious Recipes) plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'details[].icon' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.10.11 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The payload bypasses wp_kses_post on save because Gutenberg serializes block attribute JSON with JSON_HEX_QUOT, encoding double-quotes as \u0022 so no raw quote or angle bracket appears in post_content; parse_blocks() restores the literal quote at render time, producing the HTML attribute breakout.

The WP Delicious – Recipe Plugin for Food Bloggers (formerly Delicious Recipes) plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'recipeTitle' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.10.10 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. WordPress core's block-attribute kses pass strips HTML tags but preserves bare double-quote characters, allowing a payload such as x" onerror="alert(1) to survive both the save pipeline and the render-time strip_tags() call, breaking out of the alt attribute of the rendered img element.

The Flying Images: Optimize and Lazy Load Images for Faster Page Speed plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'post_content' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.4.16 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Although wp_kses_post sanitizes post content on save, the payload is kses-legal at save time; the plugin's output-buffer rewrite transforms it into an executable form at render time by overwriting the valueless data-src attribute with the unescaped src value, meaning save-time sanitization provides no effective mitigation.

The Image Source Control Lite – Show Image Credits and Captions plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'meta[isc_image_licence]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.14.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with author-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The licence display feature must be enabled in the plugin settings (enable_licences option), which is a standard configuration for sites using the licence-attribution functionality.

The Widget Manager Light plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'posts' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.18 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

The (Simply) Guest Author Name plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the user Biographical Info (description) field in versions up to, and including, 4.42. The plugin unconditionally calls remove_filter('pre_user_description', 'wp_filter_kses') at plugin load (sfly-guest-author.php:17), which strips WordPress core's sanitization of the user description field for users who lack the unfiltered_html capability (Subscribers, Contributors, Authors). This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in their own profile Biographical Info that will execute whenever a user accesses a page rendering that author's description (such as an author archive or a single-post author bio in default WordPress themes like Twenty Seventeen and Twenty Fifteen).

The WP Coder – Insert & Manage Code Snippets plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'alt_text (WP media REST) → _wp_attachment_image_alt post meta' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 5.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with author-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires that an admin-authored image-type snippet exists on the site, as the attacker uploads an image via the standard WordPress media REST endpoint, sets its Alt Text to a double-quote-based payload that survives WordPress core's sanitize_text_field(), and then publishes a post embedding the shortcode.

The Orbit Fox: Duplicate Page, Menu Icons, SVG Support, Cookie Notice, Custom Fonts & More plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'title (post_title)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.0.13 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with author-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The exploit is further enabled by wptexturize deliberately skipping texturization of content inside <code> elements and the default WordPress kses allow-list preserving <code> tags and raw double quotes on save, allowing a crafted title attribute breakout payload to survive storage and the the_title filter chain intact.

The Masteriyo LMS – LMS Course Builder, Quizzes & Certificates plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'content' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.5.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. On a default install, any unauthenticated visitor can self-register as a Masteriyo Student through the plugin's public /account/signup/ form without administrator approval, granting them the publish_course_reviews capability required to submit reviews and exploit this vulnerability.

Obot from 0.9.0 before 0.27.0 contains a command injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to execute shell commands by embedding an EOF line in file-type MCP server configuration values. Attackers can terminate the heredoc in the generated init container script to run commands, modify the MCP server files volume, and reach services on Obot's Docker network.
Tanium addressed an improper signature validation vulnerability.
Tanium addressed an improper access controls vulnerability.

Chamilo LMS is an open-source learning management system. Prior to 2.0.3, public/main/course_description/course_description_controller.php assigns contentDescription directly from a teacher's request in the Doctrine-based add and edit paths without cross-site scripting sanitization. The stored value is rendered by src/CoreBundle/Resources/views/Course/about.html.twig through description with raw output, and the /course/{id}/about route is publicly accessible. A teacher can store active content that executes when an authenticated or unauthenticated visitor views the course description, enabling session theft, credential phishing, defacement, or actions in an authenticated victim's session. This issue is fixed in version 2.0.3.

Chamilo LMS is an open-source learning management system. Prior to 1.11.40, main/inc/ajax/user_manager.ajax.php exposes the update_users action without an authorization check and stores attacker-controlled firstname, lastname, and email values without HTML sanitization. An unauthenticated attacker can modify another user's profile fields, and the stored content executes when user_portal.php, the administrative user listing, user information, social profile, course participant list, or message-composer recipient header renders the modified account. Targeting an administrator account can expose administrator-session data or permit actions in that session. This issue is fixed in version 1.11.40.

The ITRO Popup Plugin plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'custom_html' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 5.2.6 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This is only exploitable by low-privileged roles such as Subscriber when an administrator has explicitly granted that role access to the plugin settings page via the plugin's role selection option.

The User Frontend – Membership, User Registration, User Profile, User Directory & Content Restriction with Frontend Post Submission plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including, 4.3.14 via the `draft_post()` function. This is due to the function storing the `post_content` parameter via `wp_insert_post()` without the protected-shortcode allow-list check that was introduced in 4.3.14 for the sibling `submit_post()` handler — a gap that `wp_kses` filtering does not close, as it strips only HTML tags while leaving shortcode text such as `[wpuf-registration role="editor"]` intact. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Author-level access and above, to embed a registration shortcode in a post and cause any site visitor who subsequently registers through the rendered form to receive Editor-level access. The render-time `wpuf_modify_shortcodes` filter that is designed to neutralize protected shortcodes provides no protection here because posts created via the `wpuf_draft_post` AJAX endpoint carry no `_edit_last` post meta, causing the filter to return the content unchanged and allowing the shortcode to render and execute fully.

Dokploy is a free, self-hostable Platform as a Service (PaaS). Prior to 0.31.0, failed Railpack builds and database backups propagate an execution error containing the full command, exposing application environment variables, database passwords, and S3 access keys embedded in those commands. When the corresponding App Build Error or Database Backup notification setting is enabled, the disclosure can send secrets to email, Slack, Discord, Telegram, or webhooks; the same secrets are written separately to persistent Dokploy container logs, which may be accessible to more principals than the affected service. This issue is fixed in version 0.31.0.

advisories.title: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-35 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the MNG decoder that allows attackers to expose uninitialized memory by supplying a crafted image. Attackers can submit malicious MNG files for processing to leak uninitialized memory contents, potentially revealing sensitive data from the process.

ImageMagick before 7.1.2-35 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the RLA decoder that returns images containing uninitialized data. Attackers can supply a crafted RLA image to cause the decoded output to include uninitialized memory, potentially disclosing heap information.

ImageMagick before 7.1.2-35 contains a use after free vulnerability in the MSL decoder that can be triggered when processing crafted MSL image files. Attackers can supply a specially crafted MSL image to cause memory corruption, potentially crashing the application or leading to further compromise.

ImageMagick before 7.1.2-35 contains a use after free vulnerability in the EXR decoder that is triggered when a specific memory allocation fails. Attackers can supply crafted EXR images processed under memory pressure to trigger the use after free, causing crashes or memory corruption.

Parse Server before 8.6.119 and 9.x before 9.10.8-alpha.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows LiveQuery clients without the master key to subscribe to installation and internal classes. Attackers can receive installation IDs and device tokens of other devices when these classes are in liveQuery.classNames, then modify those installations to redirect push notifications.

NocoDB before 2026.10.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to download data exports by reconstructing predictable file paths under nc/uploads/data-export. Attackers can derive paths from the table id, base, table and view titles, and export time to read full exports, including fields hidden from public shared views.

NocoDB before 2026.10.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows holders of revoked OAuth access tokens to authenticate as first-party sessions by presenting them through the session header. Attackers can bypass revocation, client-existence, route allowlist and granted_resources scope checks to modify victim profiles, upload to storage, and force global sign-outs.

NocoDB before 2026.10.1 contains a user enumeration vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to identify pending invitees through a distinct sign-in error message. Attackers can submit sign-in requests where validateUser in auth.service.ts skips password comparison for saltless invited accounts, confirming the email address has an account.

NocoDB before 2026.10.1 contains a user enumeration vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to determine registered email addresses by observing differing sign-up endpoint responses. Attackers can submit addresses to signup in users.service.ts and compare error messages to identify existing accounts and pending Enterprise invitations, even under invite-only signup.

MISP (Malware Information Sharing Platform) contains an authorization bypass in the SharingGroup model's captureSGExisting method. The authorization check used a logical AND condition that effectively exempted users with the sync permission (perm_sync) from the membership verification. Specifically, the original condition 'if (!checkIfAuthorised(...) && !perm_sync) return false' meant that any user holding the sync role would pass the check regardless of whether they were actually a member of the target sharing group.

A sync user who knows or can discover the UUID of a non-local sharing group could exploit this flaw through the /sharing_groups/add endpoint or by embedding a SharingGroup object in pushed sync data. The attacker could rewrite the sharing group record to add their own organisation as a member or insert an all_orgs server entry for their MISP instance, thereby gaining read access to all events contained in that group. This exposes threat intelligence data that was intended to be restricted to the group's legitimate members.

The vulnerability requires an authenticated account with the sync role and knowledge of a valid sharing group UUID. No user interaction is required. The impact is unauthorized disclosure of shared threat intelligence events and limited integrity modification of the sharing group record.

A vulnerability was identified in Relaticle up to 3.10.0. This affects the function mapToField of the file packages/ImportWizard/src/Livewire/Steps/MappingStep.php of the component Import Wizard. Such manipulation of the argument Target leads to authorization bypass. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.

BizPrint (print-google-cloud-print-gcp-woocommerce) before 4.10.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in its Debug\Core component that allows any authenticated user, including the lowest-privilege Subscriber role, to invoke the getPrinters and sendPrintRequest AJAX actions without a nonce or capability check. Attackers can send a crafted admin-ajax.php request with an arbitrary WooCommerce order_id to dispatch print jobs for other customers' orders and disclose printer configuration, exposing cross-customer PII and abusing printer resources.

Executing a manipulation can lead to improper input validation. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been published and may be used. A vulnerability has been found in elunez eladmin up to 2.7. Affected by this issue is the function CheckBean of the file /api/jobs/exec of the component Quartz Handler. The manipulation of the argument methodName leads to improper input validation. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. A vulnerability was found in elunez eladmin up to 2.7. This affects the function SqlUtils.batchExecute of the file /api/database/upload of the component Database Maintenance Module. The manipulation results in sql injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. A vulnerability was determined in elunez eladmin up to 2.7. This vulnerability affects the function FileUtil.upload of the file /api/localStorage of the component File Upload Handler. This manipulation causes path traversal. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. A security vulnerability has been detected in SEO Panel 6.0.0. This affects the function mime_content_type of the file controllers/website.ctrl.php of the component Website Import. Such manipulation of the argument website_csv_file leads to unrestricted upload. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. Upgrading to version 7.0.0 mitigates this issue. The name of the patch is 2a2d4aeb718177327b0cd8ce17e2f40328772127. You should upgrade the affected component.

A vulnerability was detected in SEO Panel 6.0.0. This impacts an unknown function of the file controllers/siteauditor.ctrl.php of the component Site Auditor. Performing a manipulation of the argument order_col/order_val results in sql injection. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. Upgrading to version 7.0.0 will fix this issue. The patch is named 389783b5d8235f5637f4e4587f524b5fef07864d. The affected component should be upgraded.

A flaw has been found in SEO Panel 6.0.0. Affected is an unknown function of the file controllers/siteauditor.ctrl.php of the component Site Auditor. Executing a manipulation of the argument order_col/order_val can lead to sql injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. Upgrading to version 7.0.0 is able to address this issue. This patch is called 2a2d4aeb718177327b0cd8ce17e2f40328772127. It is suggested to upgrade the affected component.

MISP contains an authorization flaw in the GalaxyCluster model's captureCluster() function, which handles the import and synchronization of Galaxy Clusters. Prior to the fix, any authenticated user holding the galaxy editor role could replace an existing locked Galaxy Cluster by supplying its UUID in an import request, regardless of which organization owned the cluster. The function unconditionally called captureOrganisationAndSG() before the save operation, overwriting the cluster's org_id and orgc_id fields with the importing user's organization, effectively transferring ownership of the cluster to the attacker's organization. Additionally, the save operation was not restricted to a specific set of fields, allowing arbitrary field modification.

The vulnerable behavior required the attacker to possess a valid MISP account with the perm_galaxy_editor role and to know or discover the UUID of a target cluster belonging to another organization. No site-admin or owner-organization privilege was enforced for the update path. The result was that a low-privilege galaxy editor in one organization could modify the content (value, description, distribution, etc.) of clusters owned by other organizations and seize ownership, corrupting the integrity of shared threat-intelligence data across the MISP instance.

The vulnerability was reported by ENISA and CERT.pl. The fix introduces an explicit authorization gate that restricts cluster updates to the owner organization, a sync user who can see the cluster via sharing-group rules, or a site administrator, and enforces a field allow-list that excludes org_id and orgc_id from update writes, preserving original ownership.

MISP contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the Galaxy import/sync functionality (captureGalaxy in app/Model/Galaxy.php). The captureGalaxy() method matched an incoming galaxy payload to an existing galaxy by UUID and unconditionally overwrote the matched record, regardless of whether the importing user belonged to the owning organization or whether the galaxy was a system-provided default galaxy. Any authenticated user holding the perm_galaxy_editor role could therefore: (1) demote a default galaxy by setting its default flag to false, (2) reassign the galaxy's org_id and orgc_id to the attacker's organization, effectively taking ownership, and (3) modify other galaxy fields (name, description, distribution, version). Additionally, the role-level permission check (perm_site_admin or perm_galaxy_editor) was executed after the captureOrganisationAndSG() call, meaning organization and sharing-group data was already captured before the authorization decision was made. The vulnerability requires an authenticated user with the perm_galaxy_editor role and the ability to submit a galaxy import payload containing a UUID that matches an existing galaxy. The security impact is loss of data integrity across the MISP instance: default galaxy definitions are corrupted, cross-organization ownership is silently transferred, and the integrity of shared threat-intelligence galaxy metadata is compromised for all users of the instance.

nVision sends user's token via query parameters of GET requests. An attacker who obtains valid token can gain access to the victim's account and perform actions on their behalf.


This issue was fixed in version 18.
IBM Financial Transaction Manager (FTM) 3.2.13.0 through 3.2.13.0 Interim Fix 006 stores potentially sensitive information in environment variables that could be read by a local user.

Virtual Keyboard plugin for SquirrelMail through 0.9.1 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject script by supplying unsanitized input in the passformname parameter. Attackers can craft GET requests to /plugins/vkeyboard/vkeyboard.php with script payloads in passformname to execute code in victims' browsers and steal session cookies. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-23.

Tiny Tiny RSS before commit c68ac04 (2019-03-03) contains an open redirect vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to redirect users through the unvalidated 'return' parameter. Attackers can craft requests to /public.php?op=login with an absolute external URL in 'return', which is placed in the Location header to send victims to attacker-controlled sites. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2026-02-26.

Gnuboard5 5.0.1 before 5.3.3.3 and 5.4.0.1 before 5.4.0.2 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts through the arr_ajax_msg parameter. Attackers can craft GET requests to /plugin/sms5/ajax.sms_emoticon.php, where common.php's @extract($_GET) injects the value into the echoed JSON output, executing script in victims' browsers. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-23.

OTOBO 10.0.1 before 10.0.13 contains an open redirect vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to redirect users by supplying arbitrary URLs to the ExternalURLJump action. Attackers can craft GET requests to /otobo/index.pl?Action=ExternalURLJump with a malicious URL parameter, which the ExternalURLJump.pm module redirects to without an allow-list check, enabling phishing attacks. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-23.

Open Journal Systems 2.1.0 before 3.0.0 contains an open redirect vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to redirect users to external domains by abusing the source parameter. Attackers can send GET requests to /index.php/index/user/setLocale/<locale> with a source value beginning with '@', which UserHandler.inc.php appends to the server host, redirecting victims to attacker-controlled sites for phishing. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2024-12-05.

PMB 7.3.1 before 7.3.15 and 7.4.x before 7.4.5 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject script through unescaped POST parameter names. Attackers can send crafted parameter names to opac_css/index.php extended_search, which empr.inc.php and languages.inc.php reflect into hidden form inputs to execute JavaScript. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-23.

Reddit Top RSS through commit 5e38bfd contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts through the unescaped score GET parameter. Attackers can craft links with a score value that closes the input value attribute in html.php, executing JavaScript in victims' browsers. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-19.

JoomBri Careers 3.3.0 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts through the 'keyword' parameter of the /for-jobseekers/search-jobs endpoint in com_jbcareers. Attackers can craft malicious URLs using an attribute-breakout payload with onfocus and autofocus to execute arbitrary JavaScript and steal session tokens or credentials. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-23.

SLiMS Senayan Library Management System 9.4.0 before 9.4.2 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in the destination parameter of /index.php?p=member, which is echoed unmodified into the login form action attribute. Unauthenticated attackers can craft a malicious destination value to inject script and hijack PHPSESSID sessions of victims who access the link. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-23.

Tiki Wiki CMS Groupware 12.12 through 12.14, 15.5 before 18.10, 19.0 before 21.9, 22.0 before 24.3, and 25.0 contain a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts through the objectId parameter of tiki-ajax_services.php. Attackers can send a crafted GET request with the comment controller and list action to execute arbitrary JavaScript and steal session tokens or credentials. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-19.

phpLDAPadmin 1.1.0 before 1.2.5 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts through the dn parameter of cmd.php?cmd=template_engine. Attackers can supply an unparseable dn value that pretty_print_dn returns unescaped in the 'No such entry' error, executing JavaScript in victims' browsers. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-23.

Bagisto 2.1.0 before 2.2.1 contains a client-side template injection vulnerability in the search page where the 'query' parameter is rendered unescaped inside a Vue app root. Unauthenticated attackers can send crafted VueJS template expressions to the /bagisto-common/search endpoint via the 'query' parameter to execute arbitrary JavaScript in victims' browsers. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2024-07-30.

A out of bounds read after using negative integers during offset calculation during PCF decoding in X.Org libXfont before 2.0.10 could be used by authenticated X clients to crash the X server or expose sensitive information in its memory.

IBM Engineering AI Hub 1.0.0 through 1.4.0 is vulnerable to cross-site scripting. This vulnerability allows an unauthenticated attacker to embed arbitrary JavaScript code in the Web UI thus altering the intended functionality potentially leading to credentials disclosure within a trusted session.

In specific versions of Octopus Tentacle, Tentacle fails to unset registration credentials as environment variables, resulting in deployment scripts potentially having the ability to read those credentials.

The Check & Log Email – Easy Email Testing & Mail logging plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.0.17 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation requires an administrator to open the relevant log entry and click the planted anchor link in the Preview panel, at which point the ThickBox gadget parses the title attribute as live HTML in the wp-admin origin. Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.

The Flexible PDF Invoices for WooCommerce & WordPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'billing_address.first_name / extensions.wpdesk-flexible-invoices-checkout._billing_vat_number' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.1.2 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Execution requires an administrator to open the invoice edit page for the attacker's order and interact with (e.g., type into or trigger a change/keyup event on) a field in the customer metabox, at which point the payload stored in billing fields such as first_name or _billing_vat_number is decoded from its entity-escaped input value and passed unsanitized to jQuery .html(). Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.

The Majestic Support – The Leading-Edge Help Desk & Customer Support Plugin plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'mjsupport_message' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.2.4 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation requires that a staff member or administrator opens the affected ticket and clicks the attacker-planted link on the ticket-detail screen, as the VenoBox payload is triggered on click rather than on page load. Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.

Retool versions 3.253.0 before 3.253.19, 3.254.0 before 3.284.12, and 3.285.0 before 3.300.4 contain a DOM-based cross-site scripting vulnerability in the custom-component-collections.html postMessage handler that imports received code without origin validation. Unauthenticated attackers can send crafted postMessage events that load attacker-controlled code via data:text/javascript URIs to execute arbitrary JavaScript in the victim's context. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2026-04-22.

LimeSurvey 6.5.0 before 6.16.11 contains an open redirect vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to redirect users by supplying arbitrary values to the url parameter. Attackers can send crafted GET requests to index.php?r=editorLink, where EditorLinkController concatenates url and route unvalidated, redirecting victims to attacker-controlled sites for phishing. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2026-03-20.

cPanel & WHM 11.134.0.13 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts through the mpidentity parameter of /mailman/listinfo. Attackers can send crafted requests with a script-context breakout payload in mpidentity to execute arbitrary JavaScript in the victim's browser. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2026-06-08.

A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the Public News Article Rendering Module of PHPGurukul News Portal Project v4.1 allows authenticated attackers with administrative or sub-administrative privileges to inject arbitrary HTML and JavaScript through the postdescription parameter when creating or editing news articles. The application renders the stored post content without proper output encoding in news-details.php, allowing injected JavaScript to execute in the browsers of users who visit the affected article.

Relative path traversal in the object detection dataset preparation tool in AutoGluon Multimodal before 1.6.0 might allow adversary-in-the-middle attackers to write arbitrary files with the privileges of the user running the tool via a crafted dataset archive substituted for a dataset downloaded over plaintext HTTP.



To remediate this issue, users should upgrade autogluon.multimodal to version 1.6.0 or later.
